uds.text: Keld is where Gatha, expelled for splicing Phyrexian DNA into test subjects, continues his experiments, and Kreig seizes power in the nation with Gatha at his side.
Croag starts a war to retrieve the research, and Gatha and Kreig jump off a cliff to keep their knowledge from Phyrexia.

pcy.text: The Keldons launch the Prophecy War by invading Jamuraa, where Teferi and Barrin defeat and destroy Latulla's banished followers.

Eladamri makes peace with Warlord Astor as Skyshroud overlays Keld, and on the frozen lake Phyrexian necromancy raises the Keldon honored dead until Tajamin shatters the ice with her sacred cudgel, sinking most of both armies.
The Golden Argosy then carries the surviving Keldons to Urborg for the final battle against Yawgmoth.
